body.name: \mathcal M_K=\{P^{\mathrm{mix}}_{K,q}:q\in\mathcal R_K^{\circ}(r)\}
body.construction: For each \(q\in\mathcal R_K^{\circ}(r)\), let \(\Gamma_{K,q}\) make the \(K\) cell pairs independent with \(\Gamma_{K,q}(\theta_{0j}=u,\theta_{1j}=v)=(1+quv)/4\) for \(u,v\in\{-1,1\}\). Put \(A_{K,q}=\{|\rho_K-q|\le s_K\}\), \(\Pi_{K,q}^{\mathrm{shell}}=\Gamma_{K,q}(\,\cdot\mid A_{K,q})\), and \(P^{\mathrm{mix}}_{K,q}=\int P^{\mathcal F_K}_{K,\theta}\,d\Pi_{K,q}^{\mathrm{shell}}(\theta)\). Thus the parameter is the lattice point \(q\), the mixing law is a product law before conditioning, and its conditional support lies in \(\mathcal T_K(r)\). For any \(\rho\in[-r,r]\), boundary comparison uses the exact projection \(q_K(\rho)\), for which \(|q_K(\rho)-\rho|\le 2s_K+2/K\).
